name: OpenClaw Interaction Bridge v2
description: Bridge OpenClaw agent state, approval requests, and notifications to Snarling (physical display + A/B buttons)

presenceTarget.description: Agent ID to route presence_settled/presence_change events to. Default: 'main' (current behavior). Set to 'environmental' to route to the environmental agent. Set to 'disabled' to disable event routing entirely.

environmentalEventsEnabled.description: Whether to register the /environmental-event HTTP route and process incoming environmental/thermal events. Default: true. Set to false to completely disable environmental event processing (no route registered, no agent wake calls, no observation reports).
